name: Compute average cortexmap data for group analysis
summary: Averages cortexmap surfaces and surface measures across subjects on a common standard mesh with Connectome Workbench and builds a thresholded group parcellation, for group analysis.
description: Averages each surface (wb_command -surface-average), shape file and func metric across the input cortexmaps (subjects missing a metric are skipped for that metric), and merges the parcellation labels into a probability map that is thresholded and dilated into a group label file. Inputs must already be resampled to the same standard mesh; use the Sum App instead when you need summed rather than averaged maps.

inputs.description: cortexmaps of several subjects resampled to the same standard mesh (e.g. with the resample App); the first input defines which files are processed.
inputs.requirements: At least two cortexmaps with identical vertex counts and file names; the code always reads the first two inputs.

outputs.description: Group cortexmap with averaged surfaces and metrics and a group parcellation (*.group.label.gii).

parameters.description: Probability threshold applied to the merged subject labels: a vertex keeps a parcel label in the group parcellation only where the fraction of subjects with that label exceeds this value.
Distance used by wb_command -metric-dilate (nearest) to fill vertices left unlabeled in the group parcellation after thresholding.
